zh.title: 项目与开源贡献
zh.subtitle: Agent 工程 · 可恢复执行 · 工具可靠性
zh.project_intro: 面向维护长任务中断、重复请求与验收失真，开发可恢复的软件维护运行器，交付补丁及可复查的验证记录。
bullets: 连接 SQLite 检查点与隔离 Git worktree，保留工具进度和失败候选；在 Deep Agents、OpenHands SDK、Google ADK 三个真实仓库验证正常运行与三处 SIGKILL 恢复，各自补丁一致。
实现固定原版测试验收、Python 语法导出检查与验证进程监督；对补丁、日志、反馈和缓存做哈希校验，拒绝被改写的验收记录。
发送 HTTP 前持久化预留请求次数及 JSON 字节额度，跨重启、跨修复轮次共享；74 项完整回归通过，覆盖 503、超时、在途 SIGKILL 与并发争抢。
zh.project_scope: 三仓库恢复采用固定工具计划，不计模型自主修复。30 分钟真实 CPU 试验保存 5 次回复、6 条工具结果，仍无编辑、补丁或验收。预算单位为 HTTP 请求和 JSON 字节，非 token 或费用。

contributions.name: OpenHands SDK
contributions.text: 修复撤销写入失败后历史被提前消耗的问题；真实权限故障前后对照，185 项相关检查通过。

contributions.name: Google ADK
contributions.text: 修复产物并发删除中的文件消失竞态；Python 3.11 / 3.13 各 2021 项相关测试通过、26 项预期失败，保留嵌套产物。

contributions.name: Semantic Kernel
contributions.text: 修复实验性 Python 运行时取消回调重入死锁；103 项关联检查通过，真实请求取消后正常关闭。广泛套件仍有 12 项原版已有失败。

zh.paper_text: 第一作者 · IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, vol. 22, 2025。研究前视声纳图像的轻量化目标检测。
zh.scope: PR 状态核验于 2026-11-21：三份均为开放草稿，未合并；测试组范围重叠，不累加。Agent 工程实现与验证由 Codex 辅助完成，人工复核与上游评审仍待完成。

en.title: Projects and contributions
en.subtitle: Agent engineering / Recoverable execution / Tool reliability
en.project_intro: A software-maintenance runner for interrupted tasks, repeated requests and unreliable acceptance, delivering reviewable patches with verification records.
bullets: Connect SQLite checkpoints and isolated Git worktrees to retain tool progress and failed candidates. Normal execution and three staged SIGKILL controls produce matching reference patches within each of three repositories: Deep Agents, OpenHands SDK and Google ADK.
Add frozen original-test acceptance, Python syntax checks before export and verifier process supervision. Hash-check patches, logs, feedback and cached results to reject modified acceptance records.

Reserve HTTP attempts and serialized JSON bytes durably before send, shared across restarts and repair rounds. All 74 project checks pass, covering 503s, timeouts, in-flight SIGKILL and competing processes.
en.project_scope: Recovery uses explicit operator plans, not autonomous repairs. A real 30-minute CPU trial retains five replies and six tool results but no edit, patch or acceptance. Limits count HTTP attempts and JSON bytes, not tokens or money.

contributions.name: OpenHands SDK
contributions.text: Preserve undo history after a failed restoration write. Real permission-fault reproduction and 185 related checks pass.

contributions.name: Google ADK
contributions.text: Handle disappearing files during concurrent artifact deletion while preserving nested artifacts. Python 3.11 / 3.13 each pass the same 2,021 related tests with 26 expected failures.

contributions.name: Semantic Kernel
contributions.text: Release the experimental Python runtime token lock before callbacks. 103 related checks pass and real runtime cancellation completes; 12 existing broader-suite failures remain.

en.paper_text: First author. IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, vol. 22, 2025. Lightweight object detection in forward-looking sonar imagery.
en.scope: PR status checked 2026-11-21: all three are open drafts, not merged. Test scopes overlap and are not added. Codex assisted engineering implementation and verification; human author and upstream reviews remain pending.
